Connects a callback that fires once when the signal is next fired, then disconnects itself.

Write the Luau implementation.

```luau
function Signal:Once(handler)
	local connection
	connection = self:Connect(function(...)
		connection:Disconnect()
		handler(...)
	end)
	return connection
end
```

Reparents every descendant of the supplied model into a new folder, keeping relative CFrames intact.

Write the Luau implementation.

```luau
local function collect(model: Model, folder: Folder)
	for _, child in model:GetDescendants() do
		if child:IsA("BasePart") then
			child.Parent = folder
		end
	end
end
```

Steps each registered animation track forward by the supplied delta time and drops finished ones.

Write the Luau implementation.

```luau
function Player:StepTracks(dt: number)
	for i = #self._tracks, 1, -1 do
		local track = self._tracks[i]
		track.elapsed += dt
		if track.elapsed >= track.length then
			table.remove(self._tracks, i)
		end
	end
end
```

Sets the part's CFrame so that it rests flush on top of the supplied base part.

Write the Luau implementation.

```luau
local function stackOn(part: BasePart, base: BasePart)
	part.CFrame = base.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, base.Size.Y / 2 + part.Size.Y / 2, 0)
end
```
